name: Edification
overview: The Scriptures emphasize that edification is the purposeful building up of the body of Christ through ministerial gifts and mutual exhortation, as seen in 1 Corinthians where prophecy is highlighted as a means to edify, exhort, and comfort the church. Ephesians further teaches that edification is essential for perfecting the saints and fostering unity in faith and knowledge of Christ, guarding believers against deceptive teachings. This process involves self-denial and love, promoting peace and maturity within the church, ultimately aiming for the full stature of Christ.
